record.question: You _______ when I entered the room.
record.explanation: Answer D: were sleeping. The past progressive “were sleeping” describes an action in progress when the speaker entered (D). Independent check: Past progressive describes sleeping in progress when the past event “entered” occurred. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/idiom; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
